description: An add-on for the GTNH edition of Thaumic Energistics (Minecraft 1.7.10) that introduces an interface capable of outputting both items and essentia simultaneously for automated alchemy.

item: P2P Tunnel - ME Essentia Dual Interface

releases.notes:
**v1.0.3 Release Notes**

1. Fixed extra essentia appearing in the ME network when an interface drew essentia from a tube.
2. Fixed P2P essentia interfaces losing their configuration and inventory after a restart.
3. Fixed essentia in other tanks blocking extraction from the requested side in sided mode.
4. Fixed essentia in the crafting buffer being unavailable for extraction in sided mode.
5. Fixed essentia interface parts no longer drawing essentia after going to sleep.
6. Fixed crafting inputs being lost when the whole batch didn’t fit, and expanded the crafting buffer from 10 to 32 slots.
7. Fixed goggles showing stale inventory readings on block essentia interfaces.
8. Removed incorrect direction labels from the GUI of P2P essentia interface parts.
9. Essentia interfaces no longer automatically unpack physical essentia packets in processing patterns.
10. Fixed regular and P2P essentia interface parts drawing essentia through faces they aren’t mounted on.
11. Fixed excess essentia in interfaces no longer returning to ME automatically after a restart.
12. Fixed tubes getting stuck on the first essentia type when transferring multiple types.
13. Fixed essentia packet decoders automatically sending essentia to ME without a channel.
14. Fixed essentia potentially going missing after a chunk reload when an interface had automatically restocked or returned essentia to ME.
15. Fixed goggles showing stale readings after a decoder sends essentia to ME.
16. Fixed P2P essentia interfaces losing their existing configuration and inventory when bound with a memory card.
17. Fixed essentia interfaces drawing essentia from outside the network without a channel.
18. Fixed supported upgrade cards failing to install in essentia interfaces.
19. Fixed essentia-only processing patterns failing to engage crafting locks when inputs were sent.
20. Fixed crafting locks failing to release when essentia outputs returned to ME.
21. Fixed essentia-only processing patterns sending inputs to inactive interfaces.
22. Fixed decoders deducting some essentia even when an extraction request failed because there wasn’t enough to supply the full amount.
23. Fixed packets being taken twice through a decoder GUI left open after the block was removed.
24. Fixed essentia restocking stopping after a block interface’s item configuration was cleared.
25. Fixed essentia settings being omitted when moving a block interface with a wrench or copying interface settings with a memory card.
26. Fixed integer overflow when adding up essentia inventory counts.
27. Fixed players still being able to change essentia settings after their BUILD permission was revoked while the GUI was open.

Sorry the code was such a mess, there were so many bugs, and it took me this long to fix them. \_(:з」∠)\_

A future version will remove the essentia crafting buffer from interfaces. Essentia ingredients will stay in the AE2 crafting CPU until drawn, and you’ll be able to see how much is left on the crafting CPU screen. I’ll also keep testing the mod with newer versions of its dependencies, including AE2 and Thaumic Energistics, and fix any compatibility issues I find.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CaelixOrbit/ThaumicDualityInterface/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3
